products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory and the applied research arm of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its public-facing work centers on the Falcon family of large language models, which the institute describes as generative AI models aimed at making advanced AI accessible across industries and geographies. TII is a non-profit organization, and it has established a separate non-profit body called the Falcon Foundation specifically to champion the open-sourcing of generative AI models and to support sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.

The Falcon model family spans several distinct releases and architectures. Falcon 180B, trained on 180 billion parameters and 3.5 trillion tokens, is positioned for both research and commercial use and has appeared at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models. Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, was described as the first open-source LLM of its kind released with weights for research and commercial use. Newer additions include Falcon-H1, which uses a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture and is described by TII as outperforming Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and Falcon-E, designed with efficiency and global scalability in mind. The family also includes Falcon Arabic, focused on Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects, Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model, and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities. Falcon 2 11B is noted as outperforming Meta's Llama 3 8B and performing on par with Google's Gemma 7B model, as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard.

Per the held facts, TII's flagship product, Falcon (TII), is tracked in the Chat and General LLMs category, is licensed under Apache 2.0, and is noted for UAE hosting, sovereign AI positioning, and Middle East data residency. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
